name: grpcgap-marketplace
description: Marketplace for grpcgap, which finds gRPC method names and service configs in Go code that match nothing or that grpc-go silently ignores.

plugins.name: grpcgap
plugins.description: Find "/pkg.Service/Method" strings and grpc.WithDefaultServiceConfig settings in Go code that never apply: stale interceptor allow-lists, misnamed methodConfig entries, and retry policies grpc-go ignores.
